title: Gredwitch FX for LVS REWRITE
description: Client-side visual compatibility layer: replaces LVS vehicle effects (muzzle flashes, tracers, impacts, explosions, smoke, fire, trails) with Gredwitch-style particles. Uses PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW on resolved muzzle attachments; leaves LVS damage, ballistics, physics and networking untouched.
